# PseudoSky/adhd

> Monorepo of @adhd packages — code-first API generation (apigen), agent orchestration, task DAG dispatch, and graph-store backlog. MIT licensed.

## Key packages

- [apigen](https://github.com/PseudoSky/adhd/tree/main/packages/apigen/apigen-core-client): Code-first API generation — derive JSON Schemas from TypeScript types and live-mount to HTTP, MCP, CLI, OpenAPI, Python, and Java with zero codegen
- [agent-mcp](https://github.com/PseudoSky/adhd/tree/main/entrypoint/agent-mcp): Agent orchestration as an MCP server — providers, tools, plugins, multi-agent execution
- [dispatch](https://github.com/PseudoSky/adhd/tree/main/packages/dispatch/dispatch-core-client): Task-DAG orchestration engine — typed specs, dependency ordering
- [backlog](https://github.com/PseudoSky/adhd/tree/main/entrypoint/backlog): Graph-store backlog for multi-agent teams — CLI + MCP
- [data-query-engine](https://github.com/PseudoSky/adhd/tree/main/packages/data/data-query-engine): In-memory SQL query engine for browser and Node
- [decompile](https://github.com/PseudoSky/adhd/tree/main/entrypoint/decompile-cli): Decompile and deobfuscate bundled JavaScript
